author: hyuccc
body: Hello, this is jads. I was banned because i was using hacks for a little. The reason i think i should be unbanned is because 1.) I was only trying them out and i did not actually use them to help my team win or kill people. If you look at my ban report, it said i used rapid fire, but i was only curious about it and shot it in a different direction. 2.) I only used them for like 1 minute then i thought about my wrongdoings and was going to delete them but i got banned 3.) This is my only account and me and my friends play this a lot and i would be really disappointed if i could not play with them. I hope you take this into consideration. Oh ya if you don't know by now my Minecraft username is : jads
